name: Sub Account Identification 75
definition: Account to or from which a securities entry is made.

AccountOwner.name: Account Owner
AccountOwner.definition: Party that legally owns the account.

SafekeepingAccount.name: Safekeeping Account
SafekeepingAccount.definition: Account to or from which a securities entry is made.

ActivityIndicator.name: Activity Indicator
ActivityIndicator.definition: Indicates whether there is activity or information update reported in the statement.

BalanceForSubAccount.name: Balance For Sub Account
BalanceForSubAccount.definition: Net position of a segregated holding, in a single security, within the overall position held in a securities subaccount.

SubSafekeepingReportingRule.definition: Use of consolidated reports on a sub-safekeeping account must be bilaterally agreed between sender and receiver.

ActivityAndBalanceForSubAccount1Rule.definition: If the ActivityIndicator is "true" (Yes), then at least one occurrence of BalanceForSubAccount must be present.

ActivityAndBalanceForSubAccount2Rule.definition: If the ActivityIndicator is "false" (No), then BalanceForSubAccount must be absent.
